data.narrative:
Mangrove Lithium is a Series C climate and energy company that has raised $163.1M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a peer universe of 9 private companies and 1 public comparable (LNZA), with particular focus on three same-sector, same-stage peers: KoBold Metals ($3.0B), Electric Hydrogen ($1.0B), and Amogy ($700M).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy valuation base, applies a typical Series C step-up multiplier of 1.7x to the $163.1M raised, yielding $277M. Peer-median analysis across the three stage-matched comparables produces a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $700M to $3.0B. This broad peer dispersion reflects heterogeneous technology maturity and capital intensity within the climate-tech sector at this stage.

Synthesizing both methods yields a triangulated range of $236M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median implied value of $639M. The stage-progression method anchors the lower bound, while peer multiples support the upper range. Key uncertainties include technology differentiation relative to KoBold and Electric Hydrogen, unit economics trajectory, and pathway to revenue generation. The $464M spread between low and high reflects material estimation risk typical of pre-revenue frontier-tech valuations.
